replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged exact terminal owner/state lookup change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in exact terminal owner/state lookup; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Terminal list owner/state filters are additive in client v0 and apply before pagination. Old unfiltered clients remain supported; new filtered clients refuse old servers that do not acknowledge the requested filters. Upgrade the daemon before using filtered lookup; continuation cursors must repeat the filters.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by exact terminal owner/state lookup; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: Launchers using st terminals ls --owner or --state need an upgraded serving daemon. An old daemon produces an upgrade refusal rather than an unfiltered match; unfiltered listing remains available.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
